# Vendored: miniz

Used by `libprisma3d/src/prisma3d/core/ZipArchive.cpp` to read `.zip` archives from memory.

- `miniz.h`, `miniz.c` — the classic amalgamated two-file build of miniz
  (https://github.com/richgel999/miniz). MIT license — see `LICENSE`.

Neither file is modified. `miniz.c` is compiled once, as part of the library.
